name: Fashion
overview: Scripture teaches that clothing and outward appearance, while necessary and ordained by God as seen in His provision of coats for Adam and Eve, must reflect godly principles rather than mere worldly fashion. God commands clear distinctions in dress between men and women, warning that crossing these boundaries is an abomination to Him. True beauty is not found in external adornment or fleeting favor but in the fear of the Lord and discretion, as earthly treasures and superficial beauty are ultimately vain and corruptible.
